subject: MAP: evidence windows & DPA timing for SOC 2 / SIG review
messages:
From: Lydia Chen <security@pegasusfinance.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>; Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>; Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 20 Oct 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Mutual action plan: SOC 2 / SIG / DPA timing & evidence windows

Team —

Thanks for the MAP draft earlier. As we start to lock timelines on our side I need to clarify three items that will affect our acceptance timeline: SOC 2 evidence window, SIG/CAIQ questionnaire timing, and the DPA retention carveouts. High level asks: 

1) SOC 2: we need confirmation of the most recent audit period and whether you can provide a summary report + continuous monitoring evidence for the prior 12 months. If your SOC 2 is in progress, what are the target dates?

2) SIG/CAIQ: can Redwood run through the SIG gaps within the next two weeks? We want to avoid a multi-week back-and-forth — a single 90-minute walkthrough that references the CAIQ spreadsheet would be ideal. Please include the technical owner for KV cache encryption and key rotation.

3) DPA & retention: our legal team flagged two exceptions — (a) 90-day logs retention for debug tokens, and (b) an archival window for support tickets (we retain for 5 years). Are you able to agree to per-customer retention windows or do you have a single org-wide policy? If per-customer settings are possible, what's the lead time to enable them in Private/Dedicated?

We'd like to sync and formalize these into the MAP so we can set a go/no-go on 2028-01-15 for production.

Attachments: sample retention matrix (we'll upload to the Drive).

Thanks,
Lydia Chen
Head of Security Operations
Pegasus Finance

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
To: Lydia Chen <security@pegasusfinance.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 20 Oct 2027 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mutual action plan: SOC 2 / SIG / DPA timing & evidence windows

Lydia —

Appreciate the clear list. I've pulled together a concise MAP update and proposed timings below so we can lock this into your procurement runway. Summary first, then specific asks and owners.

Summary (high-level)
- SOC 2: Redwood completed SOC 2 Type II (security + availability) for period 2026-04-01 to 2027-03-31. We can provide the auditor summary (SOC 2 PCAOB letter) and a redacted report for review. Full report requires an NDA — we can fast-path that.
- SIG/CAIQ: We can run a single 90-minute walkthrough this week. Owner: Marcus Lin (serving runtime + encryption).
- DPA/Retention: Redwood supports per-customer retention buckets in Dedicated and Private; hosted customers use org defaults but we can apply exceptions via a signed addendum for contractually required retention windows. Legal owner: Kimberly Park.

Proposed MAP milestones (dates are US/Pacific):
- 2027-10-22: SIG walkthrough (90m) — Marcus (technical) + Evelyn (accounts) + Lydia + Andre
- 2027-10-25: Deliver SOC 2 summary + redacted report link (requires signed NDA) — Evelyn
- 2027-10-28: Draft DPA addendum with retention carveouts (Kimberly)
- 2027-11-04: Mutual signoff on MAP milestones and gating checklist (target)

Notes / clarifications:
- SOC 2 evidence: we will include the RI audit summary (rw_inference_SOC2_summary_2027Q2.pdf) and have a short evidence index that maps each control to sample artifacts. Continuous monitoring: we can provide cloud provider audit trails and stream-level incident logs for the past 12 months; debug token logs are stored for 90 days by default but that is configurable for Dedicated/Private.
- SIG lead: Marcus will map CAIQ items that are dependent on runtime vs platform controls. Expect a handful of items flagged "requires evidence" and ~3 technical follow-ups (KV encryption key rotation policy, TLS intercept exceptions, and third-party subprocessor list).
- DPA: Kimberly will propose language for retention carveouts and an operational runbook for changing retention on a per-customer basis (lead time 5 business days for Dedicated; 10 business days for Hosted with an addendum).

Attachments: MAP-v1-pegasus.xlsx (draft with milestone rows and owners). I've dropped the file and the SOC2 summary into the Drive link below. If that works for you I will schedule the SIG walkthrough for Friday morning.

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cPGS-8421-MAP
HubSpot (deal): https://app.hubspot.com/deals/12345/p/PGS-8421

Next steps: confirm availability for 2027-10-22 10:00–11:30 PT or propose two alternate slots.

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: Lydia Chen <security@pegasusfinance.com>; Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 21 Oct 2027 08:17:00 -0700
Subject: Draft DPA addendum and retention carveouts (pegasus)

Hi Lydia / team —

Following Evelyn's MAP outline, attached is a short DPA addendum (Pegasus_DPA_redline_v2.docx) that isolates the retention language into a single schedule. Key points: 

- Default log retention remains 90 days for debug/diagnostic tokens for Hosted customers. For Pegasus (as a Dedicated / Private customer) we are offering a 365-day option for security logs, and a separate archival window for support records up to 5 years as requested.
- We added an operational SLA: Redwood will enact retention changes within 5 business days for Dedicated deployment and within 10 business days for Hosted after the signed addendum is received.
- Escrow option: if Pegasus needs longer-term access to key materials for audits, we can add a controlled escrow clause and KMS key-handling appendix; this will require proof of audit authority and a limited-scope access request.

Open items for your legal team to confirm: specific retention thresholds per data class (we used: debug tokens = 90/365, usage aggregates = 2 years, support tickets = 5 years). If you need a per-customer matrix with exact field-level retention we can produce that.

Attachment: Pegasus_DPA_redline_v2.docx (redline with acceptance comments).

Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Contracts & Security
Redwood Inference

From: Andre Willis <andre.willis@pegasusfinance.com>

Date: Thu, 21 Oct 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mutual action plan: SOC 2 / SIG / DPA timing & evidence windows

Thanks — that schedule looks good and clears up a lot. Quick responses to open items: 

1) SOC 2: we can sign an NDA to get the redacted report; please send the NDA template and a link to the redacted PDF by 2027-10-25 so our audit team can triage. If we get the report by 10/25 we can slot the final compliance review for the week of 11/06.

2) SIG walkthrough: confirmed for 2027-10-22 10:00–11:30 PT. Attendees on our side: Lydia (security), myself (ops), and our CISO (will dial in for the first 15 minutes). Please send the CAIQ spreadsheet you will annotate during the session.

3) DPA retention: the 5/10 business day operational lead times are acceptable. Regarding escrow: our auditors will ask for an evidence escrow option; could you add draft escrow language as a separate appendix to the redline so we can share with our counsel?

Action items we will do on our side: sign NDA (Andre) and circulate a preferred DocuSign link for the addendum. We anticipate a conditional go/no-go by 2028-01-15 (dependent on the SOC2 evidence pass and one outstanding network segmentation item).

Attachments referenced: none. We will upload our retention matrix to the Drive today. DocuSign link (preferred): https://www.docusign.com/pgs-8421/addendum

Andre Willis
VP, Infrastructure Operations
Pegasus Finance
